ITEM.PTXT: The radiator grille emphasizes the protruding feel of the center by varying the thickness and depth of the horizontal fins. In addition, black-painted vertical ribs shaped with consideration for the lustrous surfaces, a distinctive thin U-shaped outer frame with smoked plating, and horizontal fins accentuate the premium feel.

The emblem design is based on the lowercase letter "b", the initial of "BLADE" (meaning "sword"), arranged in the image of a sharp sword tip and combined with a deep blue ornament to express high quality and elegance.
